# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents 1.

Start with the incident records. At the time the incident was reported, the person in charge of the reports and forms completed a written form. This form should contain the information he or she obtained about the situation, and should be sufficient to cover the accident. 2. Information on the incident. A written statement that was written at the time of the incident (or shortly thereafter) will give the details and the context of the incident. The information should describe the incident and the actions taken, a description of the consequences, and the steps taken to remedy the situation. 3. Reports of the incident. If you were present at the time of the accident, a report of the incident was filed by the person in charge.
